1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at a distance of sixteen inches on center.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced at a distance of twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening in the housing.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall constructed of wood or metal studs.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill that is adjustable. 

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: a housing for mounting within a structure wall, the housing containing a cooling system for evaporatively cooling an indoor area. 

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is placed between wall studs spaced at a distance of sixteen inches on center.
